Financial Analyst — AI Training Expert

About The Role

What if your deep knowledge of financial modeling could directly shape how AI performs the work of a professional analyst? We're looking for Finance Subject Matter Experts who also know their way around Python and GitHub to audit, refine, and improve AI-generated financial modeling tasks — making sure they mirror how real analysts actually work.

You'll review AI task instructions and scoring rubrics, then roll up your sleeves and edit Markdown files and Python scripts directly via Pull Requests to fix logic errors, close clarity gaps, and ensure every task meets professional standards. If you can build a DCF in your sleep and know your way around a P&L, this role was made for you.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Candidates must have strong US-based financial knowledge and fluency with American financial terminology and conventions.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Compensation: $80–$110/hour
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Audit AI-generated financial modeling tasks to ensure they accurately replicate professional analyst workflows
Validate task instructions and scoring rubrics for logical soundness, completeness, and real-world relevance
Directly edit Markdown files and Python scripts via Pull Requests to resolve logic errors, ambiguity, or clarity gaps
Evaluate whether AI outputs reflect correct application of concepts like DCF analysis, P&L interpretation, financial statement modeling, and valuation techniques
Provide clear, structured feedback grounded in professional financial expertise
Collaborate asynchronously with a distributed team using GitHub-based workflows
Work independently on task-based assignments at your own pace and schedule

Who You Are

Deep subject matter expertise in finance — you've worked as an analyst, in investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, FP&A, or a closely related field
Strong command of US-based financial terminology and frameworks (DCF, P&L, balance sheet analysis, WACC, comparable company analysis, etc.)
Proficient in Python — comfortable reading, writing, and debugging scripts used for financial calculations
Experienced with GitHub — you can clone repos, create branches, and submit Pull Requests without hand-holding
Comfortable editing Markdown for technical documentation
Detail-oriented with a systematic, quality-driven approach to review work
Clear, precise written communicator who can articulate what's wrong and why
Self-motivated and reliable when working independently

Nice to Have

CFA, CPA, or MBA with a finance concentration
Professional experience building financial models in Excel or Python for deal evaluation, forecasting, or valuation
Background in teaching, mentoring, or creating training materials for financial concepts
Familiarity with AI/ML evaluation workflows or data annotation projects
Experience writing or reviewing technical rubrics or assessment criteria

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact task-based work
Apply your hard-earned financial expertise to a genuinely novel problem — teaching AI to think like a real analyst
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

About The Company

MANTECH is a leading technology solutions provider dedicated to delivering innovative and reliable services to government and commercial clients. With a strong focus on mission-critical projects, MANTECH specializes in areas such as cybersecurity, data analytics, systems engineering, and enterprise IT solutions. The company prides itself on fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and development. Committed to excellence, MANTECH strives to provide cutting-edge solutions that meet the evolving needs of its clients and contribute to national security and technological advancement.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Analyst to join our dynamic team in Doral, FL. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in analyzing complex datasets to support operational decision-making and strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess a strong analytical background, excellent communication skills, and the ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including technical and business stakeholders, to define analytical requirements, develop dashboards, and ensure the integrity and quality of data used across the organization. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work on impactful projects within a forward-thinking company committed to technological excellence and innovation.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have a combination of education and experience that demonstrates expertise in data analysis and technical proficiency. Candidates should possess:

A bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, with at least 5 years of experience in advanced analytics roles. Alternatively, a master's degree with 3+ years of relevant experience, or a PhD with 1+ years, or an associate's degree with 7+ years, or a high school diploma with 9+ years of relevant experience.
Proven experience analyzing large, complex datasets using SQL, Python, R, or other advanced analytical frameworks.
Extensive experience in building enterprise dashboards and visual reports utilizing business intelligence tools.
A strong track record of validating data integrity, performing statistical analysis, and effectively communicating technical findings to stakeholders.
Ability to create, maintain, and communicate comprehensive technical documentation and analytical reports.

Responsibilities

The Senior Data Analyst will be responsible for a wide range of tasks aimed at supporting operational excellence and data-driven decision-making. Key responsibilities include:

Extracting, cleansing, and transforming complex structured and unstructured datasets to support operational analysis and reporting.
Designing, developing, and maintaining interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools tailored for executive leadership and operational teams.
Performing statistical analysis, data modeling, and trend evaluation to identify key operational metrics and insights that inform strategic decisions.
Collaborating with cross-functional technical teams and business stakeholders to define analytical requirements, ensure data quality, and establish data governance standards.
Conducting quality assurance, data reconciliation, and validation audits across enterprise data sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Maintaining technical baselines, analytical documentation, and reporting procedures to facilitate continuous process improvements and knowledge sharing.

Benefits

MANTECH offers a competitive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional growth of its employees. Benefits include comprehensive health insurance plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. Employees also enjoy a collaborative work environment with a focus on innovation and career advancement. The company values work-life balance and provides resources and programs to support employee wellness and engagement.

Equal Opportunity

MANTECH is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to serve our clients and fosters a culture of innovation and respect.

jobs.title: Life Sciences Associate
jobs.description:
Role overview

Osmind powers the largest network of independent psychiatry practices in the country — 1,000+ clinics — on top of our own EHR and real-world evidence platform. Our Biosciences team turns that data and clinical footprint into partnerships with biopharma companies across our four life sciences product lines: clinical real-world evidence, clinical research, commercial real-world evidence, and sales & marketing solutions. See osmind.org/life-sciences for more information.

Our Biosciences unit is a small, fast-moving team sitting at the intersection of neuropsychiatry, data, and commercial strategy — and this hire will be one of the first few people building it out. You'll have direct exposure to biopharma partners and executive leadership from your first month, and the scope of what you own will expand quickly — from contributing to workstreams, to owning them outright, to eventually shaping the direction of an engagement.

What you’ll do

Commercial modeling

Build and own commercial models detailing specific market TAMs, expected product revenues, psychiatric clinic revenue modeling, and epidemiological based forecasting
Combine clinical trial data, market research, and analyst reports into competitive landscape analyses
Build scenario-based models capable of demonstrating first and second order effects of various inputs

Research design and execution

Design, edit, program, and field quantitative surveys for a variety of clinician audiences. This includes end-to-end execution across instrument design through analysis.
Draft clinician interview guides and lead subsequent interviews
Run research operations end to end, from participant recruiting through fieldwork completion
Turn primary research and real-world evidence into insights that move a commercial project forward

Data and evidence

Analyze real-world datasets spanning claims and EHR data to find actionable insights
Design and build both prospective and retrospective data analysis projects
Track the competitive and launch landscape for the therapies our partners care about

Partnerships

This role is built for someone who will mature into a full end-to-end client lead. You will have high exposure to our partners from the start.
Build the deliverables that go to partners: presentation slide decks, handoff-ready models, conference abstracts, and more
Manage against real deadlines, including external review windows you don't control
Learn Osmind's rights-to-win well enough that you can eventually write a proposal end-to-end — scope, pricing, terms — for a new business opportunity. Sit in client and prospect meetings, help write proposals, support negotiations, and support project execution & upsell discussions.
Leverage your client-facing abilities to develop deep relationships, effectively project manage client projects, and identify and execute on cross-sell and upsell opportunities
Maintain an understanding of R&D pipelines, M&A activity, funding activity, asset development, etc. of neuropsychiatry drug and device development

Requirements

At least 2 years at a life sciences consulting firm (or within a commercial analytics, market research, business operations role within a biotech company)
Direct commercial biopharma exposure across product forecasting, launch/GTM strategy, market access, and payer dynamics
Advanced Excel skills: You've built complex models from scratch and owned them end to end. Comfortable with scenario logic, sensitivity analysis, and structuring a model someone else can pick up
Survey instrument design experience (Qualtrics, Typeform, or similar platforms)
Capable of translating both unstructured and structured data into actionable analyses and insights that solve our clients questions
Attention to detail and operational excellence
Comfort with ambiguity, and the initiative to move a deliverable forward without being told to
This role is based in San Francisco and has an in-office requirement of twice a week

Nice to have

Advanced analytics experience (Python, R, SQL)
Psychiatry, neuroscience, or CNS experience
Startup experience or small-team background
A degree in a relevant scientific field (neuroscience, biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, biostatistics, etc.)

Role structure and logistics

Reports to: Senior Manager, Life Sciences Partnerships
Compensation range: $110-125K base salary plus equity program
Start date: ASAP
Location: San Francisco (required)

Work independently on task-based assignments at your own pace and schedule

Prepare and present executive summaries, forecasts and technical reports for senior management and stakeholders.

Bachelors degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
Minimum 7+ years of progressive project management experience delivering capital projects in life sciences, pharmaceutical manufacturing or AEC sectors, with demonstrated success on complex, high value programs.
Proven experience in design engineering oversight and construction management services across mechanical, electrical, industrial and/or chemical disciplines.
Strong understanding of pharma manufacturing processes, GMP requirements, commissioning and validation practices.

Exceptional client relationship management skills with experience negotiating scope and commercial terms and maintaining senior stakeholder alignment.
